changes.from: Maker now brands it Genisom L2 (钢镚/Gangbeng; record had 'Gangben'). Speed 3.2 m/s rated, 5 m/s peak. The 70 cm obstacle headline belongs to the wheeled L2-W variant (27 kg) per maker brochure.
